Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Inference. I’m Monica (Customer Success Manager) and I’ll be leading the enablement for the initial rollout. I wanted to share an agenda and propose a cadence for live office hours and workshop sessions so your team can get to production quickly.

Attachments: enablement-agenda.pdf (high-level kickoff agenda)

Proposed weekly office hours (recurring):
- Tuesdays 11:00am–12:00pm PT (recommended)

Kickoff asks for this week:
1) Confirm a recurring attendee (technical lead) from Acme who will own follow-ups.
2) Confirm access to the staging sandbox (service account + ad hoc test data).
3) Tell us if you prefer an alternate weekly time.

We’ll record every session and post concise recordings + notes after each office hour. I’ve CC’d Rachel (AE) and Stephanie (Solutions Lead) so they’re looped in on any procurement/technical blockers.

Next steps: if Tuesday works, I’ll send a calendar invite with the first workshop topic: "API walkthrough + model selection for chat and embeddings." If not, please propose 2 alternate slots.

Best,
Monica Patel

Quick overview of the MAP (attached: acme-account-mapping.xlsx):

- Week 2: Model selection and cost-performance tradeoffs — owner: Acme ML lead, success: recommended model variant and batching plan.
- Week 3: Integration patterns, caching, and rollout checklist — owner: Dev team, success: end-to-end smoke test in staging.

Please review the MAP and add any constraints (data retention, PII rules, or security signoffs) so we can flag with our security/compliance team. Stephanie, can you confirm if a compliance questionnaire will be needed for the pilot?
